# Profiles {#admin-profiles}

A **profile** selects which tool categories a Kailash system carries;
the image name encodes its profile (see
[Install](install.qmd)):

| Profile | Carries |
|---|---|
| `minimal` | the CORE substrate — kernel, base userland, hardening, safety defaults, desktop, CLI & menu engines; no tool categories enabled |
| `redteam-ai` | the AI red-team lab scope — ATTACK core plus its OPS/DEFENCE pairings |
| `full` | the complete live catalogue ("kali-everything" lab scope) |
| `headless-agent` | base + CLI only, no desktop; the qcow2 grows at first boot |

Categories are enabled **declaratively** in the system configuration —
there is no imperative install step that drifts a system away from
its declaration. Rebuilding against the same lock reproduces the same
tool set exactly; to move up, enable more categories (per the
category-module contract every category is one module file) and
rebuild. See the build-model chapter for why nothing moves in the
background.
